audit_scope: Old-series blanket semantic holds and late new-series r8 held cases. Independent proposal only; this file edits no label or training protocol.
review_method: All31 old photographs viewed as original-pixel crops of the full labeled stack, side by side with original/PR35 and r8 labels. Larger comparative details inspected for old003,010,013,042; full originals inspected for010 and013; enlarged unannotated upper strips inspected for010,013,042. All16 late held photographs viewed as raw/r8 cropped context around every held row. No inference, image restoration, model output or automatic geometry correction used. Original image and label hashes are retained below.
limitations: Retention is a bounded visual/provenance decision, not proof of subpixel correctness of every inherited coordinate.
No label count or training-hold total was used as an acceptance target.
No actual training composition was changed or executed by this subtask.
Existing late missing endpoints remain missing; uncertainty is not converted into an empty image.
